lines.text: I pulled an all-nighter for science.

data.define: To stay awake all night to finish work or study.

example.text: I pulled an all-nighter for science.

misuse.text: Don't say you 'pulled an all-nighter' if you slept.
misuse.why: It means no sleep at all.

publish.title: What does "pull an all-nighter" mean?
publish.value: Pull an all-nighter = Stay up all night. Example: "I pulled an all-nighter for science." (casual English, US).
